title: Banana Yogurt
summary: This creamy and sweet two-ingredient banana yogurt is such an easy way to elevate your yogurt experience. Enjoy it for breakfast, snack, or dessert, topped with your favorite toppings.
ingredients: 1-2 tablespoons Peanut butter, nut butter, or sunflower seed butter
steps: Add banana to a blender and puree until smooth.
In a bowl, combine the plain yogurt with the banana puree. Stir in any of the optional add-ins.
